Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Braided Stripe Round Basket Set - Set of 3, Natural
The timeless charm of hand-braided basketry takes new form thanks to the precision of machinery. The 2 tones give these 3 baskets an artistic flair, and their handles make them great for transporting home goods. Jute Designated for storage and transport of home goods Basket measurements are 14” x 14” x 14”, 10” x 10” x 10”, 6” x 6” x 6”
